chart.name: chart

props.name: loop
props.about: For previews only: plays one chart movement over and over, such as a line drawing in or bars growing. off keeps them still.

props.name: lite
props.about: A lighter way of drawing charts for smaller panels. auto picks it on the smaller panel, on and off force it.

colour.name: colour

props.name: group

icons.name: icons

props.name: section

props.name: search

props.name: size

props.name: accent

props.name: boxes

props.name: animated

props.name: phase
props.about: The moon phase the moon icons show: 0 is new, 0.5 full.

layout.name: layout

props.name: section
props.about: Which part of the layout page to show, such as the screen areas, the devices or the size classes.

mascots.name: mascots

props.name: section
props.about: Which part of the mascot page to show, such as the moods or the usage rules.

props.name: colour
props.about: The mascots' colour: each mood's own colour, or one fixed colour.

props.name: reduced_motion
props.about: Shows the mascots as they look when reduced motion is turned on: still.

props.name: bench

motion.name: motion
motion.about: Durations, easings and the motion patterns components use, including the reduced-motion rule.

props.name: section
props.about: Which part of the motion page to show, such as the easing curves or the durations.

props.name: reduced_motion
props.about: Shows the motion as it looks when reduced motion is turned on.

props.name: loop
props.about: For previews only: plays one movement over and over so it can be watched. off keeps it still.

props.name: chart_lite

space.name: space

props.name: section

states.name: states

props.name: value

props.name: size

props.name: knob

props.name: state

back_button.name: Back button
back_button.about: The square back arrow at the start of a screen's header.

props.name: state
props.about: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while a finger is on it, or disabled when there is nowhere to go back to.

bar_chart.name: Bar chart
bar_chart.about: Bars on a baseline, coloured by token, with a dotted now marker. Press and drag to read a bar; they grow from the baseline when shown.

props.name: values
props.about: The height of each bar, as numbers separated by commas, one bar per number from left to right.

props.name: colour
props.about: How the bars are coloured: bands colours each bar by its price band (cheap, normal, peak); series draws every bar in the one chart colour.

props.name: now
props.about: Which bar is now, counting from 0 on the left; it gets the dotted now marker. -1 shows no marker.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the whole chart is, in pixels; 0 fills the space it is in.

props.name: height
props.about: How tall the tallest bar can be, in pixels.

props.name: scrub
props.about: Lets you press and drag along the chart to read the value of each bar.

props.name: ticks
props.about: Hour labels on the axis under the bars, every this many hours (6 = 00, 06, 12, 18); 0 shows none.

props.name: compare
props.about: An earlier period to set the values against, one number per value: the bars come in pairs, the earlier one as an outline. Empty shows single bars.

props.name: labels
props.about: One word per value (or pair) on the axis under the bars, such as the days of a week; they replace the hour labels.

props.name: legend
props.about: Words naming the series over the bars, each after its swatch: the values first, then the compare period.

props.name: marks
props.about: A moon over some bars, one word per bar: full or new (empty = none), such as the full and new moons over their days.

props.name: names
props.about: One word per bar that the reading names when you press it, such as its date; empty uses the axis words or the hour.

props.name: unit
props.about: The unit after a value when you read a bar, such as kWh or %.

props.name: colours
props.about: The bins' colours, separated by commas, the first in front: black, green, brown, blue, grey, purple, red or yellow.

props.name: size
props.about: hero is the big picture; card is the small picture at the top right of a Home card.

bins_next.name: Bins next
bins_next.about: The next bin collection: its bins drawn in their colours, when to put them out, which bins and the date.

props.name: colours
props.about: The bins' colours, separated by commas, the first in front.

props.name: caption
props.about: The small caption over the day, such as put out tonight.

props.name: accent
props.about: Draws the caption in the accent colour, for when the bins go out tonight or today.

props.name: when
props.about: The day of the collection, such as Tomorrow, Today or a weekday.

props.name: bins
props.about: Which bins go out, such as Green + Black bins.

props.name: line
props.about: The date and how often, such as Fri 24 Oct · every 2 weeks.

bottom_sheet.name: Bottom sheet
bottom_sheet.about: A choose-one list over the screen: a dimming scrim, a title with Close and picker rows; a tap on the scrim, Close or a pick closes it.

slots.name: list
slots.about: On a spec screen (in overlay): the sheet's list, filled by the spec (in + slot 0); the sheet is as tall as what is in it.

props.name: open
props.about: Whether the sheet is showing (open) or hidden off the bottom of the screen (closed). Changing it slides the sheet in or out.

props.name: list
props.about: For previews only: which made-up list fills the sheet, the speakers to play on or the light and dark theme choices.

props.name: title
props.about: The heading at the top of the sheet. Leave empty to use the list's own title.

props.name: selected
props.about: Which row is chosen, counting from 0 at the top; its radio is on.

props.name: screen
props.about: For previews only: draws a sample screen under the sheet so you can see it dim behind the scrim.

button.name: Button
button.about: A text button in four kinds (primary, secondary, outline, ghost), with an optional icon.

props.name: kind
props.about: How strong the button looks: primary is filled in the accent for the main action, secondary is a quieter fill, outline is just an edge, ghost is text only for the least important action.

props.name: label
props.about: The words on the button.

props.name: state
props.about: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, active when it is the chosen one, active-pressed while the chosen one is held, or disabled when it cannot be used.

props.name: icon
props.about: An icon shown before the words, or none for words only.

props.name: size
props.about: normal is the full button height; small is the smallest touch height with less padding, for an action inside a row such as a section header's See all.

props.name: width
props.about: hug fits the button to its words; fill stretches it across the space it is in, with the words centred.

props.name: hold
props.about: Hold to confirm, for an action that must not happen by accident such as opening a door: a tap does nothing; the button fills while held and acts only when full.

props.name: hold_label
props.about: The words shown while the button is held, such as Opening. Empty keeps the label.

props.name: hold_time
props.about: How long a hold takes to confirm, in milliseconds.

props.name: value
props.about: What a completed hold sends, such as open. Empty sends the label.

calendar_month.name: Calendar month
calendar_month.about: A month of the Calendar: the month with Today, previous and next, the weekday names, then six weeks of days, each with its number (today in the accent) and dots for its events. Tap a day to see it.

props.name: title
props.about: The month shown, such as October 2026.

props.name: here
props.about: Whether this month is the one shown: Today is offered only for another month.

props.name: days
props.about: The 42 days of the six weeks shown, a JSON list: each with its date d, number n, out (another month), today, sel (the day open), dots (up to three calendar colours, comma separated) and more (+2 when there are more).

calendar_row.name: Calendar row
calendar_row.about: One line of the Calendar: a day's label, an event (its time, its calendar's colour dot and its title) or a calendar in the calendars sheet with its checkbox.

props.name: kind
props.about: What the row is: day is a day's label over its events, event is one event, calendar is one calendar you can show or hide.

props.name: title
props.about: The words: the day (today · Thu 22 Oct), the event's title or the calendar's name.

props.name: time
props.about: An event's time, such as 16:50, now or all day.

props.name: colour
props.about: The calendar's colour for its dot: blue, ok, warn, steel, text-dim, text, error or accent.

props.name: tone
props.about: An event's moment: empty for later, now while it runs (the time in the accent), past when it is over (quieter).

props.name: first
props.about: A day's label at the top of the list, with no space above it.

props.name: status
props.about: A calendar's quieter line, such as 5 events or hidden.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether a calendar is shown: its checkbox is ticked and its dot takes its colour.

card.name: Card
card.about: A tappable Home card: an icon and label, a value or short text, and a supporting line.

props.name: label
props.about: The card's name, shown next to its icon at the top.

props.name: icon
props.about: The small icon before the name, or none.

props.name: preview
props.about: The small picture at the top right of the card, such as the weather now or the record that is playing, or none.

props.name: weather
props.about: With the weather preview: which weather icon it shows, such as rain-light (the weather now).

props.name: visual
props.about: With the media preview: the picture, as the Media screen shows it (disc, cassette, cd, vinyl or art).

props.name: progress
props.about: With the media preview: how far through the track it is, from 0 to 100. With the timer preview: how much of the running timer is left, out of 1000 (empty when none runs).

props.name: playing
props.about: With the media preview: whether it is playing (the picture turns).

props.name: art
props.about: With the media preview: the album art's address, printed on the disc, CD or record. Empty: the plain picture.

props.name: run
props.about: With the vacuum preview: run while the robot is out cleaning (progress = the run's), idle at rest (progress = the battery), off when it cannot be reached.

props.name: position
props.about: With the covers preview: how open the window is, from 0 (closed) to 100 (open).

props.name: phase
props.about: With the moon preview: where the moon is in its month, from 0 (new) through 0.5 (full) to 1.

props.name: south
props.about: With the moon preview: draws the moon as seen from the southern half of the world.

props.name: planes
props.about: With the flights preview: the aircraft round home, as the flights feed gives them.

props.name: colours
props.about: With the bins preview: the bins' colours, separated by commas, the first in front.

props.name: mode
props.about: What the middle of the card shows: value is a big short value such as 13°; text is a line of words such as the song playing.

props.name: value
props.about: The big value shown in the middle when the mode is value.

props.name: text
props.about: The words shown in the middle when the mode is text, such as a song title.
props.default: Paper Lanterns on a Quiet Evening

props.name: sub
props.about: The quieter supporting line at the bottom of the card.

props.name: tone
props.about: The colour of the supporting line: dim for normal, ok for good news, warn for something to watch, error for a problem.

props.name: accent
props.about: Edges the card in the accent colour to show it needs you now, such as a timer that is running.

props.name: state
props.about: How the card looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, unavailable when its device has no state now, or missing when Home Assistant has no such device.

props.name: press
props.about: How the card shows it is being pressed: fill darkens the whole card, border lights its edge, border-fill does both.

card_previews.name: Card previews
card_previews.about: The artwork at the top right of a Home card, at its size on the card (icon size card: 72 / 48). Plain shapes from the atoms: mascots, value arcs, bars, rings and dots.

props.name: preview
props.about: Which picture to draw, as it appears at the top right of a Home card: agents, media, a dial, a switch, the clock, a timer, GitHub, energy or lightning.

props.name: value
props.about: The level the picture shows where it has one, such as how far round the dial is, from 0 to 100.

props.name: progress
props.about: For the timer picture: how much of the running timer is left, out of 1000; 0 when no timer runs (an empty ring).

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the thing the picture stands for is on, such as the switch or the dial's light.

props.name: unavailable
props.about: Shows the picture greyed out, for a device that cannot be reached.

props.name: quiet
props.about: For the lightning picture: shows a quiet sky with no recent strikes.

cells.name: Cells
cells.about: A layout: rows of equal cells, one component in each. As many columns as cells of the minimum width fit; the cells share the rest. The Home grid.

slots.name: cell
slots.about: One card or tile per cell (a pair cell holds two read-outs, one above the other).

props.name: cells
props.about: The cells in order, separated by commas: c holds one component; p holds two half-height readouts, one above the other.

props.name: min-w
props.about: The narrowest a cell gets: tile-w for tiles (three to a row), home-card-min-w for Home cards (two to a row).

props.name: min-h
props.about: The shortest a cell gets: tile-h for tiles, card-h for Home cards.

props.name: last
props.about: A short last row: column keeps its cells the width of the rows above; fill lets them share the whole row (a lone Home card goes full width).

props.name: wide
props.about: Every cell on its own row, the full width: a wide card.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: fills the cells with cards so the layout can be seen.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.about: A small rounded box: open, in progress (an accent dot) or done (filled with a check). Tapping cycles open and done unless it is read-only.

props.name: check
props.about: Where the item is: open not started, doing in progress with an accent dot, or done filled with a check mark.

props.name: label
props.about: The words next to the box.

props.name: interactive
props.about: Lets a tap move the box between open and done. Off makes it read-only.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be used; disabled is greyed out and ignores taps.

clock_orbit.name: Clock orbit
clock_orbit.about: The Clock screen's picture: a ring of ticks with three dots orbiting inside it at different speeds, the outer one with the seconds, and one component in its centre for the time.

slots.name: centre
slots.about: One component in the middle of the ring, usually the Time with the date and the weather line (in + slot 0).

props.name: time
props.about: For previews only: a fixed time, like 10:08:30, that the seconds dot starts from. Leave empty for the real time.

props.name: animated
props.about: Moves the dots. Off holds them still where they start: a still picture.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: the real Time with the date and a weather line in the centre, or none for the empty slot.

column.name: Column
column.about: A layout: the screen as one column, a top slot for the view and a foot slot pinned to the bottom for the action buttons.

props.name: outline
props.about: For previews only: outlines the top and foot areas so you can see where the content and the buttons go.

corner_ticks.name: Corner ticks
corner_ticks.about: Small accent marks on the corners of a box that show it is active.

props.name: on
props.about: What the marks sit on: box for a card or tile, button for a smaller button.

props.name: corners
props.about: Which corners get a mark: all four, or tr-bl for just top right and bottom left.

props.name: state
props.about: active shows the marks; active-pressed shows them while the active control is held; default hides them.

count_badge.name: Count badge
count_badge.about: A small round number, such as how many items need attention.

props.name: count
props.about: The number in the badge. Above 99 it shows 99+.

props.name: tone
props.about: The badge colour, by what the number means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

props.name: zero
props.about: What happens at zero: muted shows a quiet 0; hide removes the badge.

cover_visual.name: Cover visual
cover_visual.about: A window with a roller blind, a Venetian blind or curtains in it, at the cover's position. Drag the blind's edge, or the curtains sideways, to set it.

props.name: kind
props.about: What hangs in the window: a roller blind, a Venetian blind with slats, or a pair of curtains.

props.name: position
props.about: How open the cover is, from 0 (closed) to 100 (fully open).

props.name: tilt
props.about: For Venetian blinds: how far the slats are turned, from 0 (shut) to 100 (fully open).

props.name: heading
props.about: Where the cover is moving to while it moves, from 0 to 100, shown as a thin target line. -1 means it is not moving.

props.name: draggable
props.about: Lets you drag the blind's edge, or the curtains sideways, to move the cover.

props.name: size
props.about: screen is a window that fills the space it is in; card is the small picture at the top right of a Home card.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be dragged; disabled cannot be moved; unavailable shows the cover cannot be reached.

dial.name: Dial
dial.about: A large circular control for a value such as brightness or temperature, with an on/off button in the centre.

props.name: value
props.about: The value the dial is set to, between its lowest and highest.

props.name: min
props.about: The lowest value the dial goes down to.

props.name: max
props.about: The highest value the dial goes up to.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the thing it controls is on. Off dims the dial; the button in the middle switches it.

props.name: caption
props.about: The word under the value that says what it is, such as Brightness.

props.name: unit
props.about: The unit shown after the value, such as % or °.

props.name: step
props.about: How much one step of the dial changes the value.

props.name: dimmable
props.about: Whether the value can be set. Off = an on/off light or a switch: the ring shows on or off, only the button in the middle works.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be turned; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device cannot be reached; missing shows there is no such device.

donut.name: Donut
donut.about: One arc per part, clockwise from 12 o'clock, with small gaps.

props.name: a
props.about: The size of the first part of the ring.

props.name: b
props.about: The size of the second part of the ring.

props.name: c
props.about: The size of the third part of the ring.

props.name: size
props.about: How wide the ring is across, in pixels.

empty_state.name: Empty state
empty_state.about: A quiet box for nothing here: an icon in the tone, a title and one line.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon at the top: done for all clear, alert for a problem, pr for pull requests.

props.name: title
props.about: The short heading that says nothing is here.

props.name: body
props.about: One quieter line under the heading that explains it.

props.name: tone
props.about: The icon's colour, by what the emptiness means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

entity_tile.name: Entity tile
entity_tile.about: A Home tile for one thing in the room: its icon, name and state; a tap toggles it or opens its screen.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon on the tile, picked for the kind of thing it is, such as a bulb for a light or a door for a door sensor.

props.name: label
props.about: The thing's name on the tile.

props.name: status
props.about: The short state under the name, such as 64% or Off.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the thing is on. On tiles are lit in the accent colour.

props.name: act
props.about: What a tap does: toggle switches it on or off, open opens its own screen, none does nothing.

props.name: state
props.about: How the tile looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, unavailable when the device has no state now, or missing when Home Assistant has no such device.

props.name: press
props.about: How the tile shows it is being pressed: fill darkens the whole tile, border lights its edge, border-fill does both.

focus_ring.name: Focus ring
focus_ring.about: A thin accent outline around a control that is active or selected.

props.name: on
props.about: What the outline goes round: box for a card or tile, button for a button, play for the round play button.

props.name: offset
props.about: The gap between the control and its outline: the usual focus gap, none for no gap, or a small or larger step.

props.name: disabled
props.about: Greys the outline, for a chosen control that cannot be used right now.

fw_update_view.name: Firmware update
fw_update_view.about: What the panel shows just before it installs new firmware (then the screen turns off), or a clear failure.

props.name: state
props.about: Where the update is: updating (about to install) or failed.

props.name: version
props.about: The version being installed. Empty hides it.

props.name: note
props.about: A line that replaces the default one, such as why it failed.

grid.name: Grid
grid.about: A layout of equal cells in columns: a fixed number of columns, or as many as fit a minimum cell size. Put other components in its cells (in + slot, a node may span several cells), or give it a list of items to repeat one cell per item, such as an icon per item in an entity attribute.

slots.name: cell
slots.about: One component per cell, in reading order (in + slot); a node may span several cells.

slots.name: item
slots.about: With items: the one component repeated per item (the node's cell), $item filled in.

props.name: cols
props.about: How many columns, 1 to 8. Leave it out when min is set.

props.name: min
props.about: Instead of cols: the smallest cell, as an icon size step; the grid fits as many columns as it can, so a bigger screen gets more columns. none uses cols.

props.name: gap
props.about: The space between cells: none, near, group or block (from tight to roomy).

props.name: aspect
props.about: The cell shape: square, wide (16 by 9), row (as tall as what is inside, for text like stats), or hug (each cell as wide as what is inside, the row centred, like a bar of chips).

props.name: rows
props.about: At most this many rows; 0 for no limit. A list of items that does not fit shows a last cell with +N for the rest.

props.name: items
props.about: The list to repeat one cell per item: a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute. Each cell is the node's cell template with $item (or $item.field) filled in; without a template, an icon named by the item.

props.name: empty
props.about: The words shown when the items list is empty.

props.name: outline
props.about: For previews only: outlines and names the cells so you can see where things go.

group.name: Group
group.about: A layout: a full-width row that wraps its parts, a gutter apart, for tiles, cards or a row of buttons.

props.name: align
props.about: Where the parts line up: start is the left, centre is the middle (a stack centres each part), end is the right.

props.name: flow
props.about: wrap lays the parts side by side and starts a new line when the row is full; stack puts each part under the last.

props.name: gap
props.about: The room between the parts side by side: gutter, group for a few big controls in a row (the Media screen's previous, play and next), or near for a column of buttons that belong together.

props.name: space
props.about: The room above the group: none, group for related parts, block for separate blocks, near for parts that belong tightly together, line for a line that belongs to the block above, strip for a strip under a hero and its lines.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: how many made-up tiles fill the row. 0 shows the empty layout.

header.name: Header
header.about: The row at the top of every screen: the back button (when there is somewhere to go back to), the title slot with the screen's name, the end slot, then the time. The name is a Title component the header makes from its label; a screen can put its own Title or a segmented control in the title slot instead (a segmented control keeps its own width) and any number of components in the end slot (Home puts its settings button there); a long name shortens with an ellipsis, so the end slot always fits.

slots.name: title
slots.about: The screen's name: a Title (made from the label when the screen puts none here) or a segmented control, just after the back button.

slots.name: end
slots.about: Up to four items before the time, in order: square icon buttons or status chips (a built-in screen may put its segmented control here too). The header's own settings button, shortcut and timer count as items.

props.name: label
props.about: The screen's name: the header puts a Title with these words in the title slot (empty = no title); a long one ends in an ellipsis. A component a screen puts in the title replaces it.

props.name: back
props.about: Shows the back button at the start, to return to the screen before.

props.name: clock
props.about: Shows the time at the end of the row.

props.name: time
props.about: For previews only: a fixed time to show, like 21:42. Leave empty for the real time.

props.name: settings
props.about: Puts the settings button in the end slot, before the time, as on Home.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: fills a slot with real components to see how the row fits them (a screen places its own).

hero_block.name: Hero block
hero_block.about: A screen's one big number, with a label and one line beside it; accent when it matters now.

props.name: n
props.about: The big number, such as how many things need you.

props.name: unit
props.about: A unit shown after the number, such as kWh or °C. Leave empty for none.

props.name: count
props.about: Counts the number up from 0 when it first shows, and from the old value when it changes.

props.name: label
props.about: The words next to the number that say what it counts.

props.name: line
props.about: One quieter line with the detail, under the label.

props.name: accent
props.about: Draws the number in the accent colour, for when it matters now.

props.name: role
props.about: How big the number is: display is the largest, hero a step smaller for a screen's main figure, value smaller again for a hero inside a small space such as the compact Timer ring.

props.name: layout
props.about: row puts the label and line beside the number; stack puts the label above it and the line under it, centred, such as inside a ring; stack-start is the same column at the start (left), such as beside a picture.

props.name: label_type
props.about: How the words next to the number are written: label in small capitals, or title in larger plain text.

props.name: state
props.about: default shows the number; unavailable shows a dash when the value cannot be read.

icon.name: Icon
icon.about: One icon from Facet's icon set, drawn at a size step and coloured by a tone. Pick it by name, or let an entity pick it: bind name to the entity with a map from its states to icon names. In a grid cell or a layout slot, fit: cell makes it the largest size that fits the cell.

props.name: name
props.about: Which icon to show, by its name in the icon set (bulb, door, clear-day ...). Bind it to an entity with a map to change the icon with the entity's state; a name with no icon shows a quiet outlined box.

props.name: step
props.about: How big the icon is, as a size step from small up to hero. Each icon is made for some sizes only, so the icon snaps down to the nearest size it has. Leave it out when fit is cell.

props.name: fit
props.about: step: the size comes from step. cell: inside a grid cell or a layout slot, the icon takes the largest size that fits the cell, leaving a small margin. Use step or cell, not both.

props.name: tone
props.about: The icon's colour by what it means: ink for normal, dim for quiet, accent for the screen's colour, ok, warn, error or info for a status.

icon_button.name: Icon button
icon_button.about: A button that is only an icon: a round play/pause button, or round and square icon buttons.

props.name: style
props.about: The button's shape: play is the large round play and pause button, round is a smaller circle, square has rounded corners.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon on the button, such as next, previous, play or close.

props.name: state
props.about: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, active when it is switched on, active-pressed while the active one is held, disabled when it cannot be used, unavailable when its device has no state now, or missing when Home Assistant has no such device (the same look).

label.name: Label
label.about: One line of text in a component type style and colour.

props.name: text
props.about: The words to show.

props.name: type
props.about: The text style, from the large title down to small meta text and capitals, as set in the type scale.

props.name: colour
props.about: The text colour: text for normal, text-dim for quieter, accent-text for the accent, blue, ok, warn, error, or disabled.

legend.name: Legend and axis
legend.about: Legend swatches and axis labels, on the grid.

props.name: items
props.about: The colour keys, as words separated by commas, each one shown with its swatch, such as cheap 13.5p.

props.name: ticks
props.about: The labels along the bottom axis, separated by commas, spread evenly from left to right.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the legend is, in pixels.

list_row.name: List row
list_row.about: A full-width row in a list or settings page, with an optional icon, a title and sub line, and a value, chevron or toggle at the end. A screen can put one more component in the end slot.

slots.name: end
slots.about: One component at the right end, after the value, chevron or toggle the props put there (in + slot 0).

props.name: title
props.about: The main words of the row.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon at the start of the row, or none.

props.name: sub
props.about: A quieter second line under the title. Leave empty for none.

props.name: under
props.about: A small capitals line under the title, such as a speaker's status in a choose-one list. A sub line takes its place.

props.name: tone
props.about: The icon and under line colour: dim for normal, working for something going on now, such as playing.

props.name: over
props.about: A small line above the title, for extra detail such as a flight's height and distance. Leave empty for none.

props.name: trailing
props.about: What sits at the right end: none, a value, a chevron to show it opens more, a value and a chevron, or an on/off switch.

props.name: value
props.about: The value shown at the right end when there is one, such as 42%.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the switch at the right end is on.

props.name: state
props.about: How the row looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, disabled when it cannot be used, unavailable when its device has no state now, or missing when Home Assistant has no such device.

props.name: act
props.about: tap: the row can be tapped; none: a read-out row that shows a value and takes no tap: no press look, no sound.

props.name: divider
props.about: Draws a thin line under the row to separate it from the next.

props.name: list
props.about: single is one row on its own; stack is a list of rows touching, with lines between them, one row per item of items.

props.name: items
props.about: With list stack: the rows, a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute. Each row is this node's props with $item (or $item.field) filled in; a plain item is the row's title, and an object item's title (or name), icon, sub, over, under, tone, trailing, value, on and state fields fill the props that do not name $item. No items shows the empty words, never sample rows.

props.name: rows
props.about: With list stack: at most this many rows; 0 for up to 24. A longer list ends with a +N row for the rest.

props.name: empty
props.about: With list stack: the words shown when items is empty.

mascot_mood.name: Mascot mood
mascot_mood.about: The mascot in a mood, picked directly or from what an agent is doing: working, needs you, done, error, idle or asleep.

props.name: from
props.about: How the mood is chosen: mood picks it directly; agent works it out from what an agent is doing.

props.name: mood
props.about: The mascot's mood when picked directly: idle, working, done, needs you, error or sleeping.

props.name: kind
props.about: When the mood comes from an agent: what the agent is doing, working, needs you, done or idle.

props.name: status
props.about: When the mood comes from an agent: its status line, such as done 40m ago. A task done long ago turns the mascot idle.

props.name: colour
props.about: The mascot's colour: mood uses the mood's own colour, or accent, steel or warn for one fixed colour.

props.name: scale
props.about: How big the mascot is drawn, from 1 (screen size) to 4 times.

media_art.name: Media art
media_art.about: What is playing as a full-screen picture: the album art edge to edge, nothing over it. The idle screen shows it while music plays (Settings > Idle shows). It draws nothing while paused or without art, so the clock under it shows.

props.name: art
props.about: The album art's address (the player's picture). The default is the docs' demo picture.

props.name: playing
props.about: Whether it is playing: only then is the picture shown.

media_hero.name: Media hero
media_hero.about: The top of the Media screen: the record or tape that is playing beside what it is, the track and the artist.

props.name: visual
props.about: The picture: the plain disc with a progress ring, a cassette, a CD, a vinyl record, or the album art alone (art).

props.name: state
props.about: What the player is doing, in small capitals: now playing, paused or idle.

props.name: tone
props.about: accent-text while it plays, text-dim otherwise.

props.name: title
props.about: The track, up to two lines.

props.name: artist
props.about: The artist, one line.

props.name: progress
props.about: How far through the track it is, from 0 to 100.

props.name: playing
props.about: Whether it is playing: the picture turns.

props.name: art
props.about: The album art's address: printed on the disc, CD or record (Media visuals). Empty: the plain picture.

media_visual.name: Media visuals
media_visual.about: The picture on the Media screen and its Home card: a plain disc with a progress ring, or a cassette, CD or vinyl record drawn to the real sizes. They turn at the real speeds while playing; the tape or tonearm follows the track's progress.

props.name: visual
props.about: What is drawn: the plain disc with a progress ring, a cassette, a CD, a vinyl record, or art: the album art alone, a square.

props.name: size
props.about: screen is the Media screen's picture; card is the small picture at the top right of its Home card (a square: the right end of a cassette).

props.name: progress
props.about: How far through the track it is, from 0 to 100. The tape moves from one reel to the other, or the tonearm moves in.

props.name: playing
props.about: Whether it is playing. While it plays the cassette reels or the disc turn at their real speed.

props.name: title
props.about: The track title, written on the cassette label or the record.

props.name: artist
props.about: The artist, written under the title.

props.name: art
props.about: The album art's address (the player's picture): printed on the disc face, the CD or the record's label. Empty, loading or failed: the plain drawing.

moon_icon.name: Moon phase
moon_icon.about: The moon as it looks tonight: a dark disc with the lit part for any point in the month. With its words it is one of the next phases, or the moon itself at the top of the Moon screen.

props.name: phase
props.about: Where the moon is in its month: 0 is new, 0.25 first quarter, 0.5 full, 0.75 last quarter.

props.name: size
props.about: How big the moon is drawn: the icon sizes, screen for the Moon screen's moon, tab a size down. Empty = card alone, feature in a column, screen as the hero.

props.name: south
props.about: Draws the moon as seen from the southern half of the world, where the lit side is the other way round.

props.name: layout
props.about: How the words sit with the moon: icon alone; column for one of the next phases (the phase and its day under it); hero for the Moon screen (the moon, then the phase and a line under it); line for that line alone.

props.name: label
props.about: The main words: the phase under the moon (column) or the phase name (hero), such as Full or Waxing gibbous.

props.name: value
props.about: When it comes, under the phase (column), such as Fri or 24 Oct.

props.name: line
props.about: The quieter rest of the hero line, such as 78% · full on Fri.

more_row.name: More row
more_row.about: The last row of a short list: a caps label and a chevron that open the rest.

props.name: text
props.about: The words of the row, such as how many more items there are.

props.name: state
props.about: How the row looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or disabled when there is nothing more to open.

picker_row.name: Picker row
picker_row.about: One option of a choose-one list: an icon, the name over a caps status, and a radio; tapping it moves the choice.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon at the start of the row, such as a speaker or a TV, or none.

props.name: name
props.about: The option's name, such as the speaker's name.

props.name: status
props.about: The small capitals line under the name, such as what is playing there.

props.name: tone
props.about: The status colour: dim for normal, working for something going on now, such as playing.

props.name: selected
props.about: Whether this is the chosen option; its radio is on.

props.name: mark
props.about: radio for one option of a choose-one list; check for one of a pick-many list: a checkbox showing selected, the other rows untouched by a tap (the list sends the new selected).

props.name: state
props.about: How the row looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, disabled when it cannot be chosen, or unavailable when its device cannot be reached.

props.name: list
props.about: single is one row on its own; group is a choose-one list, one row per item of items, where a tap moves the choice.

props.name: items
props.about: With list group: the options, a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute (such as a media player's source list). Each row is this node's props with $item (or $item.field) filled in; a plain item is the row's name, and an object item's name, icon, status, tone, selected and state fields fill the props that do not name $item. No items shows the empty words, never sample rows.

props.name: rows
props.about: With list group: at most this many rows; 0 for up to 24. A longer list ends with a +N row for the rest.

props.name: empty
props.about: With list group: the words shown when items is empty.

progress_ring.name: Progress ring
progress_ring.about: A ring that empties as something runs down, such as a timer, with one component in its centre for the words.

slots.name: centre
slots.about: One component in the middle of the ring, usually a Hero block with the name, the time left and when it ends (in + slot 0).

props.name: value
props.about: How much is left: out of 1000, or out of max when max is set (such as seconds left of the timer's length).

props.name: max
props.about: What value counts up to, such as the timer's length in seconds. 0 means value is out of 1000.

props.name: size
props.about: normal is the full ring; compact is smaller, to leave room under it (the Timer with several timers).

props.name: state
props.about: default shows how much is left; unavailable shows the empty track when the value cannot be read.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: a made-up Hero block in the centre (running, done or unavailable), or none for the empty slot.

qr_block.name: QR block
qr_block.about: A QR code with a caption, dark on light in both themes so phones can read it.

props.name: text
props.about: What the QR code holds, usually a web address to open on your phone.

props.name: caption
props.about: The line under the code that says what scanning it does.

radio.name: Radio
radio.about: A ring that shows which one option of a group is chosen; the picker row around it owns the choice.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether this option is the chosen one; the ring fills in.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be chosen; disabled is greyed out.

rate_strip.name: Rate strip
rate_strip.about: Price bands as a strip of runs, with a notch at now and an optional hour axis under it.

props.name: bands
props.about: The price band of each slot from midnight, separated by commas: cheap, normal or peak. Any number of slots shares the day equally (24 = hours, 48 = half-hours).

props.name: now
props.about: Which slot is now, counting from 0; it gets the notch. -1 shows no notch.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the strip is, in pixels; 0 fills the space it is in.

props.name: ticks
props.about: Hour labels under the strip, every this many hours (6 = 00, 06, 12, 18, 24); 0 shows none.

readout.name: State readout
readout.about: Reports a state and opens nothing: someone in a room, a door open, one temperature, who is home. No box, no press, no sound; two share a Home card cell.

props.name: top
props.about: For previews only: the made-up readout in the top half of the slot, such as someone in the room or a door open.

props.name: label
props.about: The name of the thing it reports on. Leave empty to use the sample's own.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon before the name.

props.name: state
props.about: The state in words, such as 21.4° or Open.

props.name: detail
props.about: A quieter line after the state, such as how long ago it changed. Leave empty for none.

props.name: tone
props.about: The colour of the state: text for normal, accent for something notable, warn for something to check, mute for quiet.

props.name: bottom
props.about: For previews only: the made-up readout in the bottom half of the slot, or none.

scroll_track.name: Scroll track
scroll_track.about: A thin bar at the right edge of a long list that shows how much is in view and where. Nothing when nothing scrolls.

props.name: items
props.about: The rows of the scrolling list, a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute. A plain item is a row's title; an object item's title (or name), icon, sub, value, trailing, on and state fields make the row. Up to 24 rows, the last a +N row for the rest. No items shows the empty words, never sample rows.

props.name: empty
props.about: The words shown when items is empty.

props.name: height
props.about: How tall the list's visible area is, in pixels.

section_header.name: Section header
section_header.about: A caption that starts a group of content, with an optional count and a meta text or action on the right.

props.name: title
props.about: The caption that starts the group.

props.name: badge
props.about: Shows a count badge after the caption.

props.name: count
props.about: The number in the badge.

props.name: tone
props.about: The badge colour, by what the number means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

props.name: zero
props.about: What happens when the count is zero: muted shows a quiet 0; hide removes the badge.

props.name: right
props.about: What sits at the right end: none, meta for a quiet line of text, or action for a tappable link.

props.name: meta
props.about: The quiet text at the right end, such as when it was last updated.

props.name: action
props.about: The words of the link at the right end, such as See all.

props.name: state
props.about: How the link looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or disabled.

props.name: size
props.about: sm is the small capitals caption; label is the larger screen label style.

segmented.name: Segmented
segmented.about: One choice out of a few, side by side: a setting with up to 3 options, or the view tabs of a screen.

props.name: options
props.about: The choices, separated by commas, up to three.

props.name: selected
props.about: Which choice is picked, by its name in lower case.

props.name: width
props.about: hug fits the control to its words; fill stretches it across the space.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be tapped; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the setting cannot be read.

sky_radar.name: Sky radar
sky_radar.about: The aircraft round home by distance and bearing, each a plane turned to its track; the lead one in the accent with a ring, an emergency in red.

props.name: planes
props.about: The aircraft to draw, as the flights feed gives them: a list of [km, bearing in degrees, track in degrees, mark, callsign, hex], mark 1 for the lead one, 2 for an emergency; the callsign shows beside the plane on the radar size. Empty is a clear sky.

props.name: size
props.about: hero is the radar beside the aircraft on the Flight radar; radar is the big one on its Radar view, with ring numbers, callsigns and planes to tap; card is the small picture at the top right of a Home card, with dots.

props.name: unit
props.about: The distance unit of the rings: km (5, 15, 30, 50) or mi (3, 10, 20, 30), as Settings > Units says.

slider.name: Slider
slider.about: A horizontal control for picking a value in a range by dragging or tapping. It fills the width it is given.

props.name: value
props.about: The value the slider is set to.

props.name: min
props.about: The lowest value, at the left end.

props.name: max
props.about: The highest value, at the right end.

props.name: step
props.about: How much the value changes from one position to the next.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be dragged; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device has no state now; missing shows Home Assistant has no such device.

slider_row.name: Slider row
slider_row.about: A slider with its name before it and its value after it, such as the volume on the Media screen.

props.name: label
props.about: The name before the slider, in small capitals, such as vol.

props.name: value
props.about: Where the slider is, from 0 to 100.

props.name: text
props.about: The value shown after the slider, such as 42 (-- when it is not known).

props.name: state
props.about: default can be dragged; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device has no state now; missing shows Home Assistant has no such device.

sparkline.name: Sparkline
sparkline.about: A thin line over the recent values with a dot on the latest one.

props.name: values
props.about: The recent values, as numbers separated by commas, oldest first.

props.name: colour
props.about: The line colour: steel, blue, accent, or text-dim for a quiet grey.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the line is drawn, in pixels.

props.name: dot
props.about: Puts a dot on the latest value at the right end.

speaker_button.name: Speaker button
speaker_button.about: The header button that opens the speaker picker; its icon turns orange while something is playing.

props.name: name
props.about: The speaker's name on the button, such as auto study when it follows you to the study.

props.name: playing
props.about: Whether something is playing. The icon turns orange while it plays.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon on the button: speaker for media, a tennis ball or a goal for the sport screens' match picker, or none.

props.name: state
props.about: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or disabled.

split.name: Split
split.about: A layout: two columns over the screen, a card-wide one for the picture or control and the rest for the words, each with a top and a foot slot.

props.name: art
props.about: Which side the card-wide column for the picture or control is on: left, or right with the words first (the Lightning map). The slots keep their numbers: 0 and 1 are always the picture column.

props.name: art_w
props.about: How wide the picture column is: card (a Home card's width), radar (the Lightning radar's square, wider) or qr (a QR code block's width, narrower).

props.name: art_mid
props.about: Centres the picture column's top slot down the screen instead of at the top (the Lightning radar).

props.name: art_fill
props.about: Makes the picture column's top slot the whole column, for a picture as tall as the screen (the Blinds window).

props.name: outline
props.about: For previews only: outlines the two columns and their top and foot areas so you can see where things go.

stat.name: Stat
stat.about: A caps label over one line of text: one fact in a column of facts.

props.name: label
props.about: The small capitals line that says what the fact is, such as trend.

props.name: value
props.about: The fact itself, such as 48 km/h.

props.name: tone
props.about: The colour of the value: dim for quiet, text for normal, warn for something to watch, ok for good news.

props.name: size
props.about: title is the usual value; body is a smaller value, for a row of facts in a narrow column (the Flight radar's hero, docs .fs-stat).

props.name: state
props.about: default shows the value; unavailable shows a dash when it cannot be read.

status_chip.name: Status chip
status_chip.about: A small tinted pill with a status dot and a short caps label, or the dot alone.

props.name: tone
props.about: The chip's colour, by what it reports: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

props.name: text
props.about: The short words on the chip.

props.name: size
props.about: chip is the pill with its words; dot is the coloured dot alone, the smallest way to show a state.

props.name: pulse
props.about: Makes the dot pulse gently, for something happening now.

status_line.name: Status line
status_line.about: One quiet line of text with a coloured status dot in front, for what is true now.

props.name: text
props.about: The words of the line.

props.name: tone
props.about: The dot's colour, by what the line reports: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

props.name: ink
props.about: The words' colour: text, or dim for a quieter line, such as a check that passed beside one that failed.

text.name: Text
text.about: Words that wrap: a headline, a paragraph or a small label, up to the number of lines it declares. Longer words end in an ellipsis on the last line.

props.name: text
props.about: The words to show.
props.default: Scan the code with your phone to join this panel's own Wi-Fi.

props.name: style
props.about: headline for a screen's big line, body for a paragraph, label for a small line in capitals.

props.name: tone
props.about: default is the main text colour; dim is the quieter one for explanations.

props.name: lines
props.about: How many lines it may take, from 1 to 4. It is always that tall; words that do not fit end in an ellipsis.

tick_ring.name: Tick ring
tick_ring.about: A ring of ticks drawn inward from its edge, every few a longer major: the basis of the dial scales, the media disc and the clock faces.

props.name: count
props.about: How many ticks go round the ring.

props.name: range
props.about: How far round the ring goes, in degrees: 360 is a full circle, 270 leaves a gap at the bottom like a dial.

props.name: size
props.about: How wide the ring is across, in pixels.

props.name: stride
props.about: Every how many ticks a longer major tick is drawn. 0 draws them all the same.

props.name: numbers
props.about: Writes a number by each major tick, as on a clock.

props.name: lit
props.about: How much of the ring is lit in the accent, from 0 to 100. -1 lights none.

tile.name: Tile
tile.about: An agent at a glance: the mascot in its mood, a two-line title and a status row.

props.name: title
props.about: The agent's name, over up to two lines.

props.name: kind
props.about: What the agent is doing: working, needs you, done or idle. The mascot's mood follows it.

props.name: status
props.about: The status line at the bottom, such as how far it has got.

props.name: state
props.about: How the tile looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or unavailable when the agent cannot be reached.

props.name: press
props.about: How the tile shows it is being pressed: fill darkens the whole tile, border lights its edge, border-fill does both.

time.name: Time
time.about: The time in fixed-width digit cells, so it never shifts as it changes.

props.name: size
props.about: How big the digits are: header for the time at the end of every screen's header (small caps, dim), compact for a small clock, mid for a card, hero for a screen's main figure.

props.name: font
props.about: The typeface of the digits: mono is the fixed-width face, inter the rounder everyday face.

props.name: format
props.about: 24h shows 13:00; 12h shows 1:00 with AM or PM.

props.name: seconds
props.about: Shows the seconds as well as hours and minutes.

props.name: date
props.about: The date under the time: none, short like MON 19 OCT, or long like Monday 19 October. The header size never shows one.

props.name: line
props.about: A quieter line under the date, such as the weather now. Only with a date; leave it out for none.

props.name: digits
props.about: Shows the time itself. Off leaves the date alone, for a face that tells the time another way.

props.name: time
props.about: For previews only: a fixed time to show, like 14:52:20. Leave empty for the real time.

props.name: day
props.about: For previews only: a fixed date to show, like 2026-10-19. Leave empty for today.

timer_chip.name: Timer chip
timer_chip.about: One of several running timers as a small chip: a mini ring, its name and the time left; tap it to show that timer, or to stop one that is done.

props.name: name
props.about: The timer's name, such as Eggs. Empty leaves the name out and makes the countdown the main text (the Timer bar).

props.name: key
props.about: What a tap sends to say which timer it is, such as its id. Empty sends the name.

props.name: left
props.about: Seconds left on the timer.

props.name: total
props.about: The timer's whole length in seconds; the mini ring shows left out of it.

props.name: state
props.about: running counts down; idle is set but not running; done has run out and shows DONE in the accent (a tap stops it).

props.name: active
props.about: Marks the chip whose timer is shown in the big ring.

props.name: unavailable
props.about: Shows the chip greyed out when the timer cannot be read; a tap does nothing but say so.

title.name: Title
title.about: The screen's name at the start of the header, in capitals; a long one ends in an ellipsis so the header's other items always fit.

props.name: text
props.about: The words to show, like Living room. It can follow an entity's name.

toast.name: Toast
toast.about: A message over any screen: a tone-tinted icon, a title over a body line, an optional action and a timer bar. Tap or swipe it away.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon at the start, picked for what the message is about, such as a timer, a person or a washing machine.

props.name: tone
props.about: The icon's colour, by what the message means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

props.name: title
props.about: The message's heading.

props.name: body
props.about: One line of detail under the heading.

props.name: action
props.about: The words of a button on the message, such as Open. Leave empty for no button.

props.name: timer
props.about: Shows a thin bar that runs down until the message goes away on its own.

props.name: life
props.about: How long the message stays: normal, or urgent which stays much longer.

toast_layer.name: Toast layer
toast_layer.about: The layer that stacks toasts over any screen (two at most), animates them in and out and plays the notify sound. Tap a row to send that tone's toast.

props.name: position
props.about: Where messages appear: from the top or from the bottom of the screen.

props.name: push
props.about: For previews only: the tone of the first sample message that arrives, or none.

props.name: stack
props.about: For previews only: how many sample messages are stacked, up to two showing at once.

props.name: timer
props.about: Shows the bar on each message that runs down until it goes away.

props.name: action
props.about: For previews only: gives the sample messages a button.

props.name: screen
props.about: For previews only: draws a sample screen under the messages.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the switch is on.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be tapped; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device has no state now; missing shows Home Assistant has no such device.

vacuum_robot.name: Vacuum robot
vacuum_robot.about: The robot vacuum seen from above inside a ring: the run's progress while it cleans, else its battery.

props.name: value
props.about: How full the ring is, from 0 to 100: the run's progress while it cleans, else the battery.

props.name: run
props.about: run while it is out cleaning (the ring and the LiDAR in the accent), idle at rest (the battery in grey), off when it cannot be reached (the empty track).

weather_icon.name: Weather icon
weather_icon.about: A weather icon from the Icons foundation; animated, its parts move gently (rays turn, clouds drift, rain falls). Reduced motion shows it still. With its words it is one of the next hours, one of the next days, or the weather now at the top of the Weather screen.

props.name: icon
props.about: Which weather to show, such as partly cloudy by day, rain or a clear night.

props.name: size
props.about: How big the icon is drawn, from the small sizes in text up to the hero size of a screen.

props.name: animated
props.about: Makes the icon's parts move gently: rays turn, clouds drift, rain falls. With reduced motion it stays still.

props.name: on
props.about: What the icon alone sits on: canvas for the screen background, card for a Card-coloured surface round it.

props.name: layout
props.about: How the words sit with the icon: icon alone; column for one of the next hours (the hour over it, the temperature under it); row for one of the next days (day, icon, weather, low, high); hero for the weather now (the temperature with the icon at the end, the condition and a line under it).

props.name: label
props.about: The main words: the hour over the icon (column), the day (row) or the condition (hero), such as now, Saturday or Partly cloudy.

props.name: value
props.about: The temperature: under the icon (column), the high at the end (row), or the big one (hero), such as 13°.

props.name: line
props.about: A quieter line: the day's weather and rain (row), or feels like, high and low (hero).

props.name: low
props.about: The day's low, before its high (row).

props.name: accent
props.about: Draws the hour in the accent colour: the hour now (column).

props.name: divider
props.about: Draws the List row's thin line above the row, for every day after the first (row).

stress.name: stress
stress.about: Bench load (not a Facet component): a ramp of moving things, one moving object of a given size, or a raw redraw of the whole screen, for the stress and capability suite.

props.name: kind
props.about: For testing only: what is drawn to load the panel, such as icons, arcs, moving shapes or a full redraw of the screen.

props.name: n
props.about: For testing only: how many things are drawn at once.

props.name: size
props.about: For testing only: how big each moving thing is, as a share of the screen.

props.name: ms
props.about: For testing only: how long one movement takes, in milliseconds.

props.name: dp
props.about: For testing only: the size of each thing, in pixels.

agent_keys.name: agent_keys
agent_keys.about: Settings > API keys: the keys scripts, automations and agents use to change this panel, each with its name, when it was last used and when it ends, and Revoke all. A script, automation or agent asks the panel for a key; the person taps Allow on the glass.

device.name: device
device.about: The panel running live: starts on Home; tap the settings button or a card to open a screen, Back to return. Every tap is handled inside the renderer, as on the device.

props.name: start
props.about: Which screen the panel starts on: Home, or Settings.

ha_link.name: ha_link
ha_link.about: Settings > Home Assistant: the panel's own link to Home Assistant (its address and a long-lived token, kept on the panel; the token is never shown back) and the entity lists the screens' pickers offer, read from Home Assistant on demand. Set with the action ha.connect; Read now = ha.entities.

props.name: url
props.about: Home Assistant's address (ha.connect on open; empty = leave it).

props.name: token
props.about: A long-lived access token (ha.connect on open; empty = keep the one set). The workbench reads through its host with the host's own token.

props.name: page
props.about: The panel's own link page, shown as a QR code while it is not linked (the panel sets it: http://<its address>/link).

home.name: home
home.about: A room's Home: its cards from the deck (tiles, cards, wide cards and read-only readouts) in rows of one size, live from the entities. Tap a tile to toggle, a card to open its screen.

props.name: page
props.about: Which page of the deck to show, by its id, such as kitchen. Leave empty for the start page.

idle.name: idle
idle.about: The idle clock: the Clock screen without its header, shown after Idle after with no touch. With Idle shows set to Album art, the art of the music playing covers it while it plays. A touch goes back to Home.

screen_set.name: screen_set
screen_set.about: One screen's settings on this panel: what it shows, on Home or not, where its data comes from and its own options (Media: the visual, the player). Opened by tapping a screen in Settings > Screens, or nav.open screen_set with params {id}.

props.name: id
props.about: Which screen's settings to show (a screen id of the deck or the factory).

screens.name: screens
screens.about: Settings > Screens: every screen of this panel with where its data comes from and an on / off toggle; a screen off leaves Home. Tap a screen for its source and options.

settings.name: settings
settings.about: Every personalisation setting of the panel, grouped, from the one settings schema: inline controls, toggles, sliders and pickers in a bottom sheet.

props.name: theme
props.about: Whether the panel is light or dark. Auto is light while the sun is up and dark after sunset.

props.name: look
props.about: The panel's theme: Facet, a theme built into the panel, or the one Home Assistant sent (facet_theme). A theme the panel refuses is never shown: Facet stays.

props.name: accent
props.about: The one colour used for what matters, such as what is playing or what needs you. current keeps the colour in use now.

props.name: textSize
props.about: How big the small text is. Large makes small text one step bigger without moving anything on the screen.

props.name: rotation
props.about: Turns the picture to match how the panel is mounted. Touch turns with it.

props.name: sounds
props.about: Turns the panel's taps and alert sounds on or off.

props.name: soundPack
props.about: Which set of sounds the panel plays, each with its own character, from soft keycaps to playful arcade blips.

props.name: volume
props.about: How loud the panel's sounds are, from 0 (silent) to 100.

props.name: idleAfter
props.about: How many seconds with no touch before the panel goes idle (the clock, or the album art while music plays). 0 never goes idle.

props.name: idleShow
props.about: What the idle screen shows. Album art shows the art of the music playing, full screen, and the clock when nothing plays or there is no art.

props.name: idleBrightness
props.about: How bright the screen is while the idle clock shows, from 10 to 100 percent.

props.name: screenOff
props.about: How many minutes with no touch before the screen turns off, counted from the last touch (the idle clock does not restart it). 0 keeps it on.

props.name: transition
props.about: How a new screen appears: instant shows it at once; rise fades its rows in from below.

props.name: updateChannel
props.about: Which firmware updates the panel offers: Stable releases, Beta builds that come more often and may have rough edges, or Dev: a nightly build of the latest code, untested, for trying fixes early. Dev can break things; switch back to Beta or Stable if it does.

props.name: toastPosition
props.about: Where messages such as a finished timer appear: at the top or the bottom of the screen.

props.name: distanceUnit
props.about: Whether every distance on the panel, such as aircraft overhead or the nearest lightning, is shown in kilometres or miles.

props.name: speedUnit
props.about: How every speed on the panel, such as wind or aircraft, is shown: miles per hour, kilometres per hour, or knots.

props.name: aiAgents
props.about: Lets scripts, automations and agents on your network change this panel. Each one asks for its own key, and you tap Allow on the panel. Off: every key is refused. Turn it on here, in the panel's editor or in Home Assistant.

props.name: sheet
props.about: For previews only: shows the picker sheet closed, open, or opening and closing over and over to check its motion.

props.name: update
props.about: For previews only: a made-up firmware update instead of the panel's own (live).

setup.name: setup
setup.about: The screen a new panel shows until it is on Wi-Fi and added to Home Assistant: a code to join its hotspot (with the password), the other ways to set it up, then each step until it is connected.

props.name: state
props.about: Which step of setting up the panel is on: no Wi-Fi yet, phone joined, Home Assistant asking, connecting, failed, connected, added, linking the screens to Home Assistant, or the hint to allow actions. The panel sets this itself; pick one here to preview a step.

props.name: way
props.about: How the panel is being set up: by joining its own hotspot from a phone, through the Home Assistant app over Bluetooth, or over a USB cable from a computer.

props.name: bluetooth
props.about: Whether this panel can be set up over Bluetooth. Off on boards without Bluetooth, which hides that option.

props.name: back
props.about: Shows a Back button. On when the screen is opened again from Settings, off on a brand-new panel.

props.name: ssid
props.about: The name of the panel's own hotspot, shown in the QR code and under Wi-Fi.

props.name: password
props.about: The password for the panel's hotspot. Each panel makes its own.

props.name: wifi
props.about: The name of your home Wi-Fi network the panel is joining, shown while it connects.

props.name: device
props.about: The name the panel shows for itself and in Home Assistant.

props.name: ip
props.about: The panel's address on your network, shown once it is connected.

props.name: link
props.about: The panel's own link page, where a phone sets its Home Assistant address and token.

spec.name: spec
spec.about: A screen built from its JSON spec (rooms, the Light screen): the same builder the panel uses; the deck puts them on Home.

props.name: screen
props.about: Which built-in screen to draw from its spec, such as the Light or Weather screen.

props.name: entity
props.about: The entity the screen shows, by its Home Assistant id. Leave empty to use the screen's own.

props.name: name
props.about: The name shown in the screen's header. Leave empty to use the screen's own.

props.name: speakers
props.about: For the Media screen: the speakers you can switch between, as entity ids separated by commas.

props.name: live
props.about: Runs the screen as on a panel: its taps open the screens it leads to, Back returns, and the screen itself shows no Back.

source.about: Where the events come from: calendars in Home Assistant, or a made-up fortnight for previews.
source.label: Source

hidden.about: The calendars turned off on the screen (the calendars sheet), as ids. Every other calendar in Home Assistant shows, each in its own colour.

view.about: Which view the screen opens on: agenda lists the next event and the days after it; month shows six weeks of days with their events.
view.label: View

now.about: For tests only: a fixed time in milliseconds for the made-up fortnight. Leave empty for the real time.

source.about: Where the energy use comes from: Home Assistant's Energy dashboard (the grid, solar and battery it already tracks: nothing to pick), a made-up time-of-use day for previews, or that day with the extras' test data (an extra tried without owning it).
source.label: Source

extra.about: One extra integration laid over the dashboard's data: the live watts, the rate now and next, the day's cheap and peak rates and events such as saving sessions. Auto picks the best one found in Home Assistant (Octopus Energy); None shows the dashboard's data alone.
extra.label: Extra data

view.about: Which view the screen shows: today (the day's half-hours) or the last 7 days against the week before.

name.about: The name shown in the header, such as Ceiling.
name.label: Name

source.about: Where what's playing comes from: every player in Home Assistant, the players of one integration (Music Assistant, Google Cast, Sonos), a Spotify account and its Connect devices, or made-up tracks for previews. The screen lists the source's speakers and follows the one playing.
source.label: Source

visual.about: What is drawn for the music: disc is a plain record with a progress ring; cassette, cd and vinyl are drawn to their real look and turn while playing; art is the album art alone, a square.
visual.label: Visual

view.about: Which view the screen shows: now (the moon tonight), details (the numbers and the next phases) or days (a bar per evening for the next weeks).

source.about: Where the moon comes from: worked out on the panel for your place, or a fixed sample evening for previews.
source.label: Source

lat.about: Your latitude in degrees (south is negative), for moonrise and moonset and which way round the moon looks.
lat.label: Latitude

lon.about: Your longitude in degrees (west is negative), for moonrise and moonset.
lon.label: Longitude

source.about: Where the weather comes from: a weather entity in Home Assistant (its forecast too), or a made-up forecast for previews.
source.label: Source

weather.about: The weather forecast to show, such as the one Home Assistant sets up for your home.
weather.label: Forecast

source.about: Where the weather comes from: a weather entity in Home Assistant (its forecast too), or a made-up forecast for previews.
source.label: Source

weather.about: The weather forecast to show, such as the one Home Assistant sets up for your home.

settings.help: Whether the panel is light or dark. Auto is light while the sun is up and dark after sunset.
settings.label: Mode

options.label: Auto
options.hint: light while the sun is up

settings.help: The panel's theme: Facet, a theme built into the panel, or the one Home Assistant sent (facet_theme). A theme the panel refuses is never shown: Facet stays.
settings.label: Theme
settings.about: Themes change the look only (colours, faces, edges, shapes); sizes, layout and touch targets stay Facet's. Every theme passes the same guards as Facet: structure, ranges, contrast in every mode and accent, press feedback.

settings.help: The one colour used for what matters, such as what is playing or what needs you. current keeps the colour in use now.
settings.label: Accent
settings.about: The one colour for what matters: playing, needs you, the hero ring. Every set passes contrast in both themes: fill 3:1 against the canvas and cards, accent text 4.5:1, label on accent 4.5:1.

settings.help: How big the small text is. Large makes small text one step bigger without moving anything on the screen.
settings.label: Text size
settings.about: Large sets the small text roles one step bigger inside the same line boxes, so nothing on a screen moves (480: titles only; body and label line boxes have no room there).

settings.help: Turns the picture to match how the panel is mounted. Touch turns with it.
settings.label: Rotate screen
settings.about: Clockwise, applied at once without a restart (panel firmware: LVGL rotation, the touch points turn with it). The workbench and docs previews stay upright.

settings.help: Turns the panel's taps and alert sounds on or off.
settings.label: UI sounds

settings.help: Which set of sounds the panel plays, each with its own character, from soft keycaps to playful arcade blips.
settings.label: Sound pack

settings.help: How loud the panel's sounds are, from 0 (silent) to 100.
settings.label: Volume

settings.help: How many seconds with no touch before the panel goes idle (the clock, or the album art while music plays). 0 never goes idle.
settings.label: Idle after
settings.about: No touch for this long: the idle screen shows (the clock without its header, or the album art). A touch goes back to Home.

settings.help: What the idle screen shows. Album art shows the art of the music playing, full screen, and the clock when nothing plays or there is no art.
settings.label: Idle shows
settings.about: Album art: while the Media feed plays with art, the idle screen shows the art edge to edge, nothing over it; paused, stopped or no art = the clock. A touch goes back to Home either way.

settings.help: How bright the screen is while the idle clock shows, from 10 to 100 percent.
settings.label: Idle brightness

settings.help: How many minutes with no touch before the screen turns off, counted from the last touch (the idle clock does not restart it). 0 keeps it on.
settings.label: Screen off after

settings.help: How a new screen appears: instant shows it at once; rise fades its rows in from below.
settings.label: Transition
settings.about: Content rise fades each new screen's rows in. Boards that can't keep up default to Instant.

settings.help: Which firmware updates the panel offers: Stable releases, Beta builds that come more often and may have rough edges, or Dev: a nightly build of the latest code, untested, for trying fixes early. Dev can break things; switch back to Beta or Stable if it does.
settings.label: Update channel
settings.about: Picks the update manifest the panel's Firmware entity checks (ota.json, or ota-beta.json or ota-dev.json beside it). Switching to another channel offers that channel's build, even when it is older. The workbench and docs ignore it.

settings.help: Where messages such as a finished timer appear: at the top or the bottom of the screen.
settings.label: Toast position

settings.help: Whether every distance on the panel, such as aircraft overhead or the nearest lightning, is shown in kilometres or miles.
settings.label: Distance
settings.about: Every distance a screen shows: aircraft overhead, the nearest lightning strike, the Overhead and Lightning radar rings.

settings.help: How every speed on the panel, such as wind or aircraft, is shown: miles per hour, kilometres per hour, or knots.
settings.label: Speed
settings.about: Every speed a screen shows: aircraft overhead, wind, a storm's approach.

settings.help: Lets scripts, automations and agents on your network change this panel. Each one asks for its own key, and you tap Allow on the panel. Off: every key is refused. Turn it on here, in the panel's editor or in Home Assistant.
settings.label: Allow API access
settings.about: Off: every write from outside the panel's own editor is refused, keys too, and no key can be asked for. On: a request with Authorization: Bearer <key> (a key from POST /fw/keys/request, allowed on the glass) can do what the editor does. Reads, /llms.txt, /agents.md, /ai and /schema.json are always open.

limits.about: Caps for memory and performance only (C48). A file over a cap is refused whole. edge_px: how far in an edge layer may reach on a part with no room of its own (drawn on every redraw); shadow_px: the largest shadow offset (a shadow is drawn outside its box). values: the JSON values a file may hold (the parse reserves its memory once: values x 24 B + the file + the scratch model stay under 64 KB, theme engine S6).

roles.about: Font roles (C49): a theme names a family per role. A type style's role decides its family.

type.about: The type styles a theme may size, each within [floor, the style's line box] at each density (Appendix A type): the box, case and letter spacing stay Facet's, so no line moves (C45). Floors are [1.5x, 1x] px; role = the font role whose family draws it.

keys.about: Style block keys (Appendix A Style block) and the part kinds that take them.
caption: face
edges
text

parts.about: The fixed list of parts (C46). keys = which style keys it takes; sits_on = the colour token under it (its outer edges and drawn ink are checked against it, C47); face = the colour token its face replaces (what the component paints there without a theme; a drawn part: the ink the component draws it in, which counts with its outer edges); texts = what is written on its face (checked on every face stop, 4.5, or the part's own text ink); press = the look keys its component changes when pressed (C36: if the theme fixes all of them, its pressed block must differ); radius = the size token whose look range a part radius must stay in; height = the size token a radius is at most half of; room = how far in its edge layers may reach (pad: the part's padding token; height + less: half of the height minus that type style's line box, so edges never reach the content; stroke: leave a pixel cell of that stroke for the part itself; buttons / width: half the caption button height / the scrollbar width; null = limits.edge_px); pad = whether a theme may pad it: a part with no content (track, track-fill: the padding insets the fill, nothing moves) or a bar (header, card-head: its vertical padding, only with flush: the frame's padding moves into the bar and the body, the content box stays, C45).

shape.about: Presets (Appendix A shape.*): each value expands to part blocks; the first value of each list is Facet's and expands to nothing, so a theme that names it changes nothing.

routes.about: {v, density, core, files, ids, built, board, w, h, shown, devices: [{stack, builds, objects}], heap}   what this firmware was built from

routes.says: How smoothly the panel draws: frames per second and render times.

routes.about: the settings backup {"facet":"settings","version":1,"values":{...}} (core/device.h; no secrets)
